_comment: NODIUM — CATEGORIES. Edit names, descriptions, icons or images here. After editing, run:  python3 tools/build.py   (regenerates the site data + category pages).

categories.name: Notion Templates
categories.short: Dashboards, databases and life systems that make Notion feel like a product.
categories.description: Turn a blank Notion workspace into a system you actually enjoy opening. Every Nodium Notion template ships as a ready-to-duplicate workspace with prebuilt views, sample data and a short setup guide — so you're productive in the first ten minutes, not the first weekend.

categories.name: Resume Templates
categories.short: Typographically precise CVs that pass ATS scanners and impress humans.
categories.description: A resume is a design problem with a 6-second deadline. Our resume templates are built on strict grids, real typographic hierarchy and ATS-safe structure — so your experience reads clearly to software and looks quietly excellent to the person who opens it.

categories.name: Website Templates
categories.short: Hand-built HTML/CSS sites for studios, products and editorial brands.
categories.description: No page builders, no bloated frameworks — just clean, hand-coded HTML/CSS/JS that you can host anywhere. Every template is responsive, fast and ships with a Figma source file so you can restyle it in minutes and keep the code honest.

categories.name: Canva Templates
categories.short: Pitch decks, social kits and brand systems you can edit in minutes.
categories.description: Professional-grade design work, without the design degree. Each Canva template is a complete, on-brand system — slide layouts, social formats and brand guidelines included — so anyone on your team can produce work that looks like it came from a studio.

categories.name: Ebooks
categories.short: Long-form guides on freelancing, finance and doing your best work.
categories.description: Practical, beautifully typeset ebooks — no filler chapters, no recycled blog posts. Every title is written from direct experience, edited hard and delivered in PDF and EPUB so it reads perfectly on any device.

categories.name: Spreadsheets
categories.short: Financial models, trackers and dashboards that behave like software.
categories.description: Spreadsheets that respect you. Every model and tracker ships with clean formulas you can audit, formatting that survives edits, and documentation on every sheet — for Excel and Google Sheets.

categories.name: AI Tools
categories.short: ChatGPT-ready systems that turn AI from a toy into a teammate.
categories.description: Most people use AI as a glorified autocomplete. These tools give it a job: research systems, content pipelines, meeting-to-action workflows — structured, tested and ready to plug into your routine.

categories.name: n8n Workflows
categories.short: Self-hosted automations that connect your stack and run your ops.
categories.description: Production-grade n8n workflows, imported in two clicks. Each workflow is documented node-by-node, uses secure credentials and is built to run on your own server — your data never touches a third-party cloud.

categories.name: AI Prompt Packs
categories.short: Tested prompt systems for writing, research, marketing and more.
categories.description: Prompts are software now. Each pack contains hundreds of prompts that have been written, stress-tested and refined against real workflows — organized, commented and copy-paste ready for any major model.

categories.name: Automation Kits
categories.short: End-to-end kits for onboarding, content, outreach and admin.
categories.description: The biggest wins come from whole processes, not single scripts. Automation kits bundle workflows, templates, checklists and guides into one drop-in system — deploy a complete process in an afternoon.
